answer: Make every key prove it really holds its own reserve. Each agent must keep a small minimum balance, and at random moments the network drills a batch of keys at once: move the full reserve to a fresh address and back within two minutes. A farm that shuffles one pot of nectar between fifty keys can only cover one drill at a time, so the rest miss the deadline and their payouts freeze. Living on that ledge gets costly fast, and over the horizon of many epochs each fake key needs real money parked behind it.
